1	const YahooFinance = require('yahoo-finance2').default
2	const yahooFinance = new YahooFinance()
3	
4	const quoteCache = new Map()
5	const CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000 // 5 minutes
6	
7	async function getQuote(ticker) {
8	  const cached = quoteCache.get(ticker)
9	  if (cached && Date.now() - cached.ts < CACHE_TTL) return cached.data
10	
11	  const result = await yahooFinance.quote(ticker, {
12	    fields: ['symbol', 'shortName', 'regularMarketPrice', 'regularMarketChange',
13	      'regularMarketChangePercent', 'regularMarketVolume', 'marketCap',
14	      'regularMarketDayHigh', 'regularMarketDayLow', 'regularMarketOpen',
15	      'fiftyTwoWeekHigh', 'fiftyTwoWeekLow', 'trailingPE'],
16	  })
17	
18	  const data = {
19	    ticker: result.symbol,
20	    name: result.shortName,
21	    price: result.regularMarketPrice,
22	    change: result.regularMarketChange,
23	    changePercent: result.regularMarketChangePercent,
24	    volume: result.regularMarketVolume,
25	    marketCap: result.marketCap,
26	    dayHigh: result.regularMarketDayHigh,
27	    dayLow: result.regularMarketDayLow,
28	    open: result.regularMarketOpen,
29	    week52High: result.fiftyTwoWeekHigh,
30	    week52Low: result.fiftyTwoWeekLow,
31	    pe: result.trailingPE,
32	  }
33	
34	  quoteCache.set(ticker, { data, ts: Date.now() })
35	  return data
36	}
37	
38	async function getQuotes(tickers) {
39	  return Promise.all(tickers.map((t) => getQuote(t).catch(() => null)))
40	}
41	
42	async function getHistory(ticker, range = '3mo') {
43	  const rangeMap = { '1d': 1, '5d': 5, '1mo': 30, '3mo': 90, '6mo': 180, '1y': 365, '2y': 730 }
44	  const days = rangeMap[range] || 90
45	  const startDate = new Date()
46	  startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - days)
47	
48	  const result = await yahooFinance.historical(ticker, {
49	    period1: startDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
50	    interval: days <= 5 ? '1h' : '1d',
51	  })
52	
53	  return result.map((row) => ({
54	    date: row.date,
55	    open: row.open,
56	    high: row.high,
57	    low: row.low,
58	    close: row.close,
59	    volume: row.volume,
60	  }))
61	}
62	
63	async function searchTicker(query) {
64	  const results = await yahooFinance.search(query)
65	  return (results.quotes || [])
66	    .filter((q) => q.quoteType === 'EQUITY')
67	    .slice(0, 8)
68	    .map((q) => ({ ticker: q.symbol, name: q.shortname || q.longname }))
69	}
70	
71	module.exports = { getQuote, getQuotes, getHistory, searchTicker }
